world_org_meetings.title: Nato welcomes Greenland deal as Trump says it will give US 'permanent security control'
world_org_meetings.description: Denmark and the US have reached an agreement after months of threats from Donald Trump to annex the territory.

world_org_meetings.title: Trump signs sweeping Russia sanctions bill
world_org_meetings.description: The bill is named after the late Senator Lindsey Graham, a staunch advocate of aid for Ukraine.

world_org_meetings.title: The new lines of southern Lebanon
world_org_meetings.description: The U.N. expanded the United Nations Interim Force in Lebanon's mandate 20 years ago to include monitoring adherence to a ceasefire in fighting between Israel and Lebanon's Iran-backed Hezbollah — the militant group created in 1982 to counter a second Israeli invasion.

world_org_meetings.title: Head of European Investment Bank eyes Canada opportunities as Carney pushes EU ties
world_org_meetings.description: The president of the European Union's investment bank says "the time is ripe" to deepen its co-operation with Canada by exploring how to finance Canadian projects — comments that come as Prime Minister Mark Carney pushes for more EU ties.

world_org_meetings.title: Canada won't pay directly into EU budget under Carney's plan: ambassador-designate
world_org_meetings.description: As Prime Minister Mark Carney presses toward creating a "unique alliance" with the European Union, Canada's ambassador is ruling out paying directly into the 27-nation bloc's budget.

diplomatic_visits.title: Defining global leadership in AI at Trump-Xi summit
diplomatic_visits.description: Former U.S. deputy national security advisor Anne Neuberger is watching for signs of competition and cooperation on artificial intelligence at President Trump and Chinese leader Xi Jinping's summit this week.

diplomatic_visits.title: Macron, Carney hail new chapter in France-Canada ties at symbolic archipelago meeting
diplomatic_visits.description: French President ​Emmanuel Macron and Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney on ​Sunday called for stronger bilateral ties in the face of new global threats at a meeting on Saint Pierre and Miquelon, a French territory off Canada's Newfoundland. The first-ever visit by a Canadian leader to the North Atlantic archipelago came as both countries have increasingly awkward relations with the US.

diplomatic_visits.title: Charles Spencer on the royal fallout following Princess Diana's death
diplomatic_visits.description: In his first interview about his new book, "Swan Song: Diana, My Sister," Charles Spencer talks about his attempt to set down what he calls the definitive story of Princess Diana.

diplomatic_visits.title: 10-year Treasury yield tops 5% as oil surges and diesel hits all-time high
diplomatic_visits.description: Talks between Iran and Gulf countries about the future of the Strait of Hormuz were delayed after a key Saudi pipeline was hit.

elections.title: German Chancellor Merz calls state election a 'disaster' for his party but vows to stay on
elections.description: Exit polls show damaging losses for Merz's centre-right CDU party in the states of Berlin and Mecklenburg-Vorpommern.

elections.title: Russia holds parliamentary vote in areas it seized from Ukraine in the war
elections.description: Russia's parliamentary election for the first time is being held in Ukraine's regions that Moscow illegally annexed after the start of its full-scale invasion more than 4 1/2 years ago.

elections.title: Putin's ruling party on track to comfortably win wartime Russian election
elections.description: Russia's ruling United Russia party was on track to easily win a parliamentary election that President Vladimir Putin has cast as a test of support for the war in Ukraine, partial official results showed on Sunday, after Ukraine launched a massive ‌drone attack on the Russian capital.

elections.title: Canada's top general is up for a senior NATO post. Will Trump get in her way?
elections.description: Canada's Gen. Jennie Carignan faces Germany's Gen. Carsten Breuer on Saturday in a secret-ballot contest to chair NATO's Military Committee. A victory would make Carignan the first woman to hold the post and return Canada to the chair after nearly two decades, amid Ottawa's push for deeper ties with Europe.

elections.title: Russia's first wartime parliamentary election shows Kremlin dominance all but assured
elections.description: The election was virtually devoid of opposition to President Putin's policies.
